## What's Changed
* Update to Pi 1.6.0 and release 0.39.2 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/418


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.39.1...v0.39.2

## What's Changed
* fix: recover raw TypeScript tool calls by @shyba in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/415
* chore(release): v0.39.1 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/416


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.39.0...v0.39.1

## What's Changed
* ci(pi-assistant): load pit v0.38.0 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/400
* fix(renderers): display labels and inputs from source headers by @kaofelix in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/401
* chore(release): v0.38.1 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/403
* Ignore withdrawn picomatch advisory in the runtime audit (#411) by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/412
* Notice replies that write an elided-call record instead of calling a tool (#409) by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/410
* Update Pi packages to 1.5.2, oxfmt 0.78.0, oxlint 1.93.0 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/413
* chore(release): v0.39.0 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/414


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.38.0...v0.39.0

## What's Changed
* ci(pi-assistant): load a labelled PR's Pit to test it on a live thread by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/398
* feat(durable): collapse finished runs' tool calls to their labels after each run by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/397
* chore(release): v0.38.0 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/399


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.37.1...v0.38.0

## What's Changed
* ci(pi-assistant): load pit v0.37.0 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/389
* Show pending outcomes, singular check counts, npm.run script names; wait until the budget is spent by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/391
* ci(pi-assistant): upgrade pi-action to v2.5.4 and drop NPM_CONFIG_ALLOW_GIT by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/393
* feat(renderers): show [skill] lines for returned skill reads by @kaofelix in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/394
* chore(release): v0.37.1 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/395


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.37.0...v0.37.1

## What's Changed
* ci: upgrade pi-action to v2.5.2 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/378
* ci(pi-assistant): install locked dependencies before pi runs by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/380
* fix(functions): make delivery helpers work first time under pi-action by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/381
* fix(gh): return whole gh.api responses and name cut-short methods by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/382
* ci(pi-assistant): let npm 12 install git extension specs by @cv in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/384
* feat(globals): npm.ci, Git branch/sync methods, looser edit types, atob/btoa by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/385
* feat(functions): pending wait outcomes, delivery.openPullRequest, pr.merge sync by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/386
* chore(release): v0.37.0 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/388


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.36.6...v0.37.0

## What's Changed
* Release v0.36.6: plan each step's tool calls into one round trip by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/377


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.36.5...v0.36.6

## What's Changed
* Release v0.36.5: harden the typescript tool's present field by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/374


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.36.4...v0.36.5

## What's Changed
* ci: run pi-action v2.5.1 with pit 0.36.3 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/371
* Release v0.36.4: typescript tool present field for pi-action by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/373


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.36.3...v0.36.4

## What's Changed
* fix(input): decode JSON string literal params; release v0.36.3 by @pi-action-agent[bot] in https://github.com/cv/pit/pull/369


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pit/compare/v0.36.2...v0.36.3
